 Applications open for LIHEAP fall heating assistance in Kentucky 
 LIHEAP (Missouri Capitol News Bureau) By WYMT Staff Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 5:50 AM EST | Updated : 8 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Ky. (WYMT) - Applications open Nov. 9 for the fall subsidy through the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, or LIHEAP, which helps eligible Kentucky households pay their heating bills.
 The fall subsidy provides a one-time payment made directly to a household’s energy provider.
 Applicants do not need to have a past-due bill or a disconnect notice to qualify. Households must meet income requirements, and applications are handled on a first come, first served basis.
 The application period runs through Dec. 18 or until funding runs out.
